cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Mrs. Bernard Sugerman, Bloomfield, New Jersey, 1955; Descended in family; Sotheby's, New York, NY, sale no. 5584, lot no. 394, 28 May 1987, no sale; (Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico); Gallerie Tokoro, Tokyo, Japan, 1989; (Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico), 1988 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. On backing: In pencil 'Bleeding Heart' 1928" [not verified]. Backing inscription dates 1931. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1928. Dated 1928 on basis of inclusion in 1929 New York (Intimate Gallery) exhibition and Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Bleeding Heart

description: The pink petals of a bleeding heart flower occupy the center of the canvas. The flower hangs from a reddish-brown stem, and several red and green leaves poke into the lower right corner of the composition. A plain white background sets off the bright colors of the flora.
title: Bleeding Heart
